static_handler.name: Type0x43PlayerInteractionHandler
static_handler.semantics: When TERRAIN_LANDING_STATE is nonzero, temporarily aligns PLAYER_X to the actor, converts the actor from type 0x43 to 0x8A, installs animation data, arms the event-99 flag, and restores PLAYER_X.

runtime_observed: At frame 1 the pre-conversion checkpoint contains actor slot 24, type 0x43, at world (2720,768).
With neutral, Up, C, A, B, C+Right, and C+Left branches, the actor is type 0x8A by the early checkpoint while SCENE_STATE remains 0x01.

The indirect player-collision trace reaches target 0x001AE64C once in the neutral branch; the explicit register breakpoint did not emit a breakpoint line, so this is retained as edge-trace evidence rather than a timing claim.
No tested branch writes the scene gates or enters SCENE_STATE=0x08.
conclusion: The type-0x43 object is a one-shot local interaction/resource conversion, not the missing level-exit connector. The pre-conversion checkpoint is now preserved for future event-99/audio correlation, but repeating controller variants here is low value.
